newsitem.title: USA: Searle to build Moscow pharmaceutical plant.
newsitem.headline: Searle to build Moscow pharmaceutical plant.

text.p: G.D. Searle & Co, a unit of Monsanto Co, said Wednesday it signed a joint venture agreement to build a pharmaceutical plant near Moscow.

The company said the pact with Biopreparaty/Russian Research Center for Molecular Diagnostics and Therapy will involve the manufacture of up to 50 different medical products. The $32-million project is expected to be operational in the second quarter of 1999, Searle said.
Searle is a developer of pharmaceuticals and other health care products, and a unit of St. Louis-based Monsanto.
Monsanto shares were off 1/8 Wednesday at 37-7/8.
